name: Potion of Fire Breath

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: For 1 hour, a Bonus Action breath of fire at a creature within 30 ft (Dex DC 13, 4d6 Fire, half on a success), three times.
text: Flickering orange liquid fills the bottle, and smoke gathers in its neck and escapes whenever it is unstoppered. After drinking it, you can breathe fire as a Bonus Action at one target up to 30 feet away, which makes a Dexterity saving throw against DC 13 and takes 4d6 Fire damage on a failure or half that on a success. You get three breaths, and the effect ends early if 1 hour passes first.
